title_en: Chinese History (7/20): The Golden Age of the Tang
note_en: 使 + object + verb/adjective means "to make someone or something do or become something": 使国家迅速富强起来 "made the country quickly grow rich and strong," 使唐朝由盛转衰 "sent the Tang into decline." It works like English "make" or "cause" with a result, but 使 is more formal than 让 or 叫, which is why it turns up so often in writing about history and politics.
